value.rationale: An exact necessary-and-sufficient classification of all consistent two-point entropy flux functions is a natural mathematical invariant of a fully discrete stable scheme, not an arbitrary small example. Its sharp width quantifies a nontrivial gap between strict half-cell sufficiency and genuine full-step feasibility; for half<nu<=1, half-cell feasibility vanishes although nontrivial universal cell entropy fluxes exist. This provides a precise design boundary for numerical entropy-flux projection and CFL reasoning, without claiming high-order algorithm guarantees.
